verdict.rationale: Claude Managed Agents is a first-party agent harness that runs in managed infrastructure for long-running, asynchronous work, and its beta webhooks report state changes without polling, so background autonomous execution is directly documented. Recurring automation is much thinner: scheduling appears only as a single pricing-page bullet ('Hand off and schedule tasks'), with no documented way to set up recurring schedules or triggers. Missing for 10: documented recurring schedule/trigger configuration, depth on how automations are defined and run unattended, non-beta status, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Pre-built, configurable agent harness that runs in managed infrastructure ... Best for: Long-running tasks and asynchronous work
Although most real-time interactions occur through the SSE event stream, webhooks notify you of major state changes.
